name: functions.distributions.permissions.list
purpose: List the access type of a custom slack function and include the users, team or org ids with access if its permission_type is set to named_entities

function_callback_id.desc: The callback ID defined in the function's definition file.

function_app_id.desc: The encoded ID of the app.

'existence-only' verified does NOT mean 'safe to call' -- it only means the method name is real.
